messages:
sophia: Quick question — need a short break-glass admin window (~10m) to flip a prod feature flag (experimental-response-fallback) and repro a customer-facing error. I can't reproduce in staging. Will only toggle on/off and capture logs. Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-3124 :eyes:

tim (sec): Tagging security here. Can you provide: justification, exact time window, list of actions, and a link to the repro steps? Also who needs access? :lock:

sophia: Justification: reproducing an intermittent tokenization fallback that happens only when fallback path is enabled. Time window: ASAP for 10m — hoping 2024-06-20 16:30–16:40 UTC. Actions: toggle flag in Console -> run the failing trace ID from support -> collect debug dump from /svc/responder (will not touch DB). Participants: me (sophia) and ryan. Repro steps: paste below.

sophia: ```1) flip experimental-response-fallback = ON
2) curl -H 'X-Trace-ID: 7f3b2a' https://api.redwood.ai/respond
3) collect /var/log/responder/debug.log and attach
```

tim (sec): Thanks. Two quick policy checks: 1) We prefer short-lived role assumption rather than console root creds. 2) Enable session recording & ensure KMS-encrypted audit log retention. I'll spin up a just-in-time role for you and ryan for the 10m window if you confirm the exact UTC times.

ryan: I can be online at 16:25 UTC to stand by. I'll only observe and help collect logs.

irene: Product/PM note: Please capture customer ID and affected request IDs and add to the Jira ticket. We need the rollback plan if flag flip worsens behavior. :clipboard:

tim (sec): Creating break-glass role: ENG-BG-1719004321-role. Rules: auto-expire at 16:40 UTC, session recorded, access only to FeatureFlagService toggle endpoint and Console UI flag. No DB access. Approver: tim (sec) or sec-bot.

sec-bot: Automated note: Temporary role ENG-BG-1719004321 created. Audit URL: https://console.redwood.ai/audit/sessions/1719004321. Session recording enabled. Please acknowledge before using.

sophia: Acknowledged. I will only toggle and run the single trace.

tim (sec): Ok granting. Steps to assume role: 1) open Console -> Switch role -> select ENG-BG-1719004321. 2) Confirm MFA. 3) Toggle flag & run repro. After 16:40 UTC the role will be revoked automatically.

ryan: If anything weird happens, I'll cut power to the canary and notify infra.

sophia: Done. I flipped flag at 16:31, ran the curl — saw the fallback behavior. Collected debug.log and uploaded to the Jira ticket (ENG-3124).

tim (sec): Confirmed session recorded. Please paste the relevant log lines here (redact any PII) and mark the ticket with the audit link.

sophia: Pasted redacted lines in the ticket and here: "[responder] fallback triggered for trace 7f3b2a — tokenization mismatch detected; fallback path executed; response latency 1.8s"

irene: Thanks team. Marking this resolved for the repro step. If we need more than 10m we'll file a new request and include risk assessment. :thumbsup:

tim (sec): Closing note: role auto-revoked at 16:40 UTC as scheduled. Audit session archived. If any leftover artifacts need access, open a scoped request.

sophia: Thanks all. Appreciated the quick turnaround. :heart:
